claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a Mitsubishi truck-mounted crane, not a borehole drilling machine.
Engine running condition is not shown in the photos.
No service records or dealer stamps are visible in the photos.
Photos show the exterior only; internal completeness cannot be confirmed.
The grille shows Mitsubishi branding, but manufacturer origin documents are not shown.

Photo of the odometer or hour meter.
Photo of the crane capacity plate or load chart.
Photo of the VIN or chassis plate and registration document.
Photo of original vehicle licence, customs papers, or proof of ownership.
